doc.title: Ira Gitler interviewed by Michael Woods, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Closing thanks
summary: Woods thanks Gitler and wraps up.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well thank you so much, and we’re going to kind of wrap up here and thank you for coming and sharing some very precious insights about some of our major icons in this idiom, and we hope that this, not only this taping of this particular session, but the information that you’re telling finds its way into the hearts of students who are interested in this art form.
